resources.string: Plug in the DVD capture card
This board has no USB host port, so you cannot plug in the DVD capture card here.
This system camera needs camera and microphone access. The USB capture card does not.
Camera permission is required for this source.
Capture card unplugged - plug it back in
USB access was denied. The DVD capture card cannot be opened without it.
Could not open that video source.
Opening the DVD capture card. Allow USB access if Android asks.
Picture-in-picture isn\'t available on this board
Snapshot saved in the app pictures folder. Allow storage access to put it in Pictures/DVD Player.
No signal - make sure the DVD player is turned on and the HDMI cable is connected
Controls are locked by the administrator
No audio input could be opened. Video continues without sound.
Allow microphone access so the DVD capture card can play sound.
Microphone permission is off, so the DVD capture card stays muted.
No audio input could be opened. Video continues without sound.
Open the last capture card as soon as it is plugged in. When nothing was remembered, start the only capture card.
Crop the picture to cover the screen when playback starts. Off leaves the whole frame visible.
Hide Change source and Zoom. Freeze and Snapshot stay if they are enabled. A teacher cannot unlock this from the board.
A small level bar in the corner that moves when the capture card\'s sound is coming through.
Save the current frame as a PNG in Pictures/DVD Player.
Hold the current picture on screen while the DVD and the sound keep playing.
How long the top buttons stay up after a tap. From 1 to 60. The default is 4.
Leave on. Hides USB vendor 0x0B8C and SMART webcam names so the board camera is not a source.
Extra USB vendor ids to hide
Comma-separated hex vendor ids, for example 0x1234,534D. Empty hides nothing extra.
Show the Picture-in-picture button and allow the floating DVD window. On by default. Off hides the button.
Home, the SMART launcher, or another app shrinks the DVD into the floating window while sound keeps playing. On by default.
